note: Classes used in markup and declared in no stylesheet. Regenerate the class list with scripts/lint-undeclared-classes.mjs --json; see --split for the two groups below. Most sit on an element another declared class already styles, so the name is a hook and not a look (DESIGN.md 7). The ones whose element carries NO declared class need a reason, and reasons{} holds it - tests/undeclared-classes.test.mjs refuses an entry without one, and refuses a reason left behind after the class was declared.

reasons.advanced: AdminView scoped `details { border, radius, padding }` styles the element by tag.
reasons.col-ci: AssignmentDetailView scoped `th {}` / `td {}` style the cells by tag.
reasons.col-score: AssignmentDetailView scoped `th {}` / `td {}` style the cells by tag.
reasons.team-name: A <strong>; the weight is the element default and that is the intent.
reasons.file-path: A <code>. The app declares no code/pre rule anywhere, so every <code> renders at the UA default - consistent, and a change there is a DESIGN decision about type, not about this class.
reasons.org-item-text: Positioned by its siblings: .org-dropdown-item is flex and .check-icon carries margin-left:auto, so the text needs no rule of its own.
reasons.admin-view: A structural page wrapper with no look of its own - the layout comes from the `.container` inside it. It USED to carry `fade-in`, which was its only declared styling and which left a permanent transform that trapped every modal on the page off-screen; removing that is what left this class bare (2026-09-02).
reasons.setup-view: A structural page wrapper with no look of its own, for the same reason as `admin-view`.
reasons.template-preflight-badge: Carries its own inline style; the badge look comes from the elements inside it.
reasons.team-action-btn: A wrapper around a .btn; the row layout is .team-item-card.
reasons.team-info: Layout container inside .team-item-card, which owns the row.
reasons.teammates-section: Layout container; spacing comes from the parent stack.
reasons.team-selection-flow: Layout container; spacing comes from the parent stack.
reasons.tab-content: Layout container for a tab body; spacing comes from the parent stack.
reasons.seed-preview: Layout container; spacing comes from the parent stack.
reasons.add-member-section: Layout container; spacing comes from the parent stack.
reasons.usage-content: Layout container; spacing comes from the parent stack.
reasons.student-dashboard: Page root. DESIGN.md 7: page roots and e2e selectors are never meant to carry a look.
reasons.not-found-page: Page root. Confirmed in the browser: no rule matches it, and none should.
reasons.usage-page: Page root. Confirmed in the browser: no rule matches it, and none should.
